notes: Each phase registers its gate cases here (verification contract). R2-1 bindings: P03 registers contract-drift, P05 registers host-registry + static-policy. Required case missing capability = BLOCKED_CAPABILITY; unimplemented gate = NOT_RUN; never empty-pass.

baseline.description: P01 exit: toolchain >=22.13, per-app npm ci, mobile test+typecheck, synthetic fixture pack provenance/zero live URLs/zero personal leftovers.

platform.description: P02 exit: full mvn verify on Boot 4.1.1/Security 7/Jackson 3, contract tests, rebuilt image digest + preserved pre-upgrade image, one-time disposable-stack boot (startup/RSS/fail-closed), env-gated *PostgresIT lock-order set on disposable postgres (zero-IT refused), plus a non-required content-audit run whose outcome is recorded for the defect ledger.

cases.description: Correction-migration IT family (policy/certificate/spring-injection/demo-team/cancellation). Authored for the audit rig at an older migration head — outcomes are recorded, not gate-blocking; failures feed the defect ledger instead of masking the lock-order verdict.

contracts.description: P03 exit: openapi regen byte-equal + invariants (required paths, no-register, upload/nullable/enum/paging fixtures) on a disposable 4100 stack, private-response no-store + X-Request-Id contract probes, log-redaction sentinel, sync-tokens byte-equal, cross-account cache test, real PostgreSQL contract families, one typecheck per app.

identity.description: P04 exit: OIDC/legacy unified session authority — H2 contract tests cover SSO discovery contract shape, JWKS rollover ring, auth-code+PKCE+nonce grant, claim-shaped tokens, resource-lane authorization, userinfo, single-use code, wrong verifier, offlist callback, missing-session redirect, suspended/must-change-password gates, ciphertext token columns, wrong issuer/audience, rollover-key decode, disabled and paused surfaces. Disposable-postgres case runs UnifiedSessionRevocationPostgresIT for legacy-replay cross-lane revoke, save/revoke race serialization, and per-client logout scoping.

bff.description: P05 exit: browser BFF + host isolation — H2 real-HTTP contract tests cover login/callback/state/logout journey, PKCE+nonce, per-transaction cookies, session-bound CSRF triple-check, surface registry fail-closed, forged proxy headers, redirect-mode surfaces, allowlisted /bff/api proxying (header strip + bearer inject + no-store), unified client-scoped revoke sweeping the BFF lane. Disposable-postgres case runs BffSessionPostgresIT for single-flight concurrent refresh (exactly-once rotation), logout-vs-refresh leaving the session dead, callback-vs-grant-deletion, account and per-client sweep, one-time transaction consume, and bounded retention. R2-1 CI gates: host-registry (doc/projection/migration parity) + static-policy (cookie/CSRF/token-leak sentinels).

content.description: P06 exit (publication-policy §8): announcement lifecycle — explicit DRAFT create, author submit, reviewer-not-author approve binding publishedRevision, mandatory return reason, expired-window approve guard + recoverable fix, archive/restore-to-DRAFT with audit, published content immutable, zero fan-out until approve, status filters, lecturer review-queue scope. Public docs — revision-pinned anonymous reads, permalink bound, VI/EN folded search, attachment gate, slug 404s. Asset gating — parent-aware attachment/media visibility across lifecycle + audience. content-e2e registers in P06e with the preview spec.

cases.description: ANN-T05: article media/attachment reads follow the parent announcement lifecycle + audience (public/scoped/section/draft/in-review/archived-expired tiers) plus v2 pagination DTOs.
HTTPS preview anonymous content journeys (publication-policy §8): seeded published news/docs visible, drafts leak nothing, revision permalink superseded, rich-text payload sanitized, VI locale.

mobile-core.description: P07 exit: native mobile core. mobile-oidc-probe proves the cu-mobile public-client OIDC contract (PKCE exchange minting a refresh token via NativeRefreshTokenGenerator, client_id-only refresh grant with rotation reuse-detection, idempotent /oauth2/revoke, suspended/mustChangePassword freshness-gate denial, PKCE-missing rejection). mobile-unit/typecheck/auth cases register as the phase implements.

cases.description: Component, accessibility-audit and structural visual (token/layout, not pixels) suites on jest-expo; device screenshots and TalkBack/VoiceOver stay BLOCKED_CAPABILITY.

events.description: P08 exit (domain-contracts §5): event lifecycle DRAFT→PUBLISHED→REGISTRATION_OPEN→REGISTRATION_CLOSED→COMPLETED|CANCELLED, owner-scoped staff publish, capacity-gated single-active registration, idempotent register replay, cancel freeing exactly one seat, event-cancel notify+retained history, roster-scoped manual attendance with zero conduct-score coupling. events-contract is the H2 MockMvc contract; events-postgres-race runs EventCapacityPostgresIT on a disposable compose Postgres; events-e2e drives the HTTPS preview create→publish→register→attend journey plus the staff roster surface. Repairs enforce event ownership for reads/mutations, stale draft version rejection, immutable replay, cancellation/side-effect invariants and VI/EN recoverable capability UI; evidence includes source manifests.

cases.description: EVT-T01..T06 + EVT-X02 on H2: lifecycle grants, capacity conflict, single-active registration, idempotency replay, cancel/notification/audit, attendance scope, negative conduct-score source scan.
VI/EN domain message parity plus dirty-aware source identity and safe preview collision regression.
EVT-X01: N-student last-seat race on real Postgres — exactly capacity succeeds, losers get EVENT_FULL not 5xx, no duplicate active registration.

HTTPS preview event journey: staff create→publish→open, idempotent student register, EVENT_FULL on overflow, cancel frees one seat, roster attendance mark, event-cancel notification + retained history, portal roster render.

learning.description: P09 exit (domain-contracts §6): assignment DRAFT→PUBLISHED→CLOSED→ARCHIVED, submission DRAFT→SUBMITTED→RETURNED→RESUBMITTED→REVIEWED with immutable revisions, section-lecturer authority, enrolled-student read-through roster, server-clock deadline, idempotent draft/submit/resubmit replay, checksum-bound file upload with owner/lecturer-scoped download, and the forbidden-write guarantee that learning never touches Enrollment/StudentGrade. learning-contract is the H2 MockMvc matrix; learning-postgres-race runs LearningAuthorityPostgresIT on a disposable compose Postgres (deadline-under-lock, same-key draft/submit races, cross-section authority); learning-e2e drives the HTTPS preview create→submit→return→resubmit→review journey with the official-grade-unchanged assertion plus lecturer/student portal render.

cases.description: LMS-T01..T07 + LMS-X01/X02 on H2: lifecycle transitions, section-lecturer scope, revoked-enrollment denial, deadline/closed rejection, immutable revisions, idempotent replay, checksum mismatch (FILE_CHECKSUM_MISMATCH), owner-scoped download, source scan proving no Enrollment/grade writes.
Native student surface: 23-screen registry incl. learning, route-map round-trip, source scans.
LMS-X01/X02 + §6 authority on real Postgres: deadline rejection under row lock, concurrent same-key draft/submit collapse to one row+revision, cross-section lecturer denial and dropped-seat refusal.

HTTPS preview learning journey: lecturer create→publish, idempotent student draft→submit, roster return, resubmit as a second immutable revision, review close, NOT_ENROLLED cross-section denial, official-grade rows bit-identical, portal lecturer/student render.

admissions.description: P10 exit (domain-contracts §7): simulated admissions lifecycle DRAFT→SUBMITTED→IN_REVIEW→RETURNED→SUBMITTED→ACCEPTED/REJECTED plus WITHDRAWN, STAFF:admissions-scoped review authority with claim/release ownership, per-cycle single-active-application uniqueness, checklist/reason review history, decisionLabel='SIMULATED' labeling, auth-user-keyed applicants (never academic Student), idempotent create/submit/attachment replay, attachment checksum + owner/staff download scope, and the forbidden-write guarantee that acceptance never creates Enrollment/Student. admissions-contract is the H2 MockMvc matrix; admissions-postgres-race runs AdmissionAuthorityPostgresIT on a disposable compose Postgres (cycle-unique race collapse, same-key submit replay, claim serialization); admissions-e2e drives the HTTPS preview applicant+staff journey with isolation and grant-authority legs.

cases.description: ADM-T01..T06 + ADM-X01/X02 on H2 (MockMvc matrix): lifecycle transitions incl. resubmit-after-RETURNED, one-active-per-cycle uniqueness, claim ownership scope on return/decision, checklist + RETURN_REASON_REQUIRED, SIMULATED decision labeling, withdraw-frees-slot, idempotent create/submit/attachment replay with same-key-different-payload conflict, FILE_CHECKSUM_MISMATCH upload rejection, owner/staff-scoped attachment download, grant-required + admin-required denials, STAFF_GRANTED/REVOKED audit rows, indistinguishable 404 isolation incl. foreign attachment reads, and the accepted-application API surface carrying no student link.
Native applicant/staff admissions surface: 24-screen registry incl. admissions, route-map round-trip, source scans.

ADM-X01/X02 + §7 authority on real Postgres: same-cycle concurrent create collapses to one application via the partial unique index, same-key submit replays one transition under the idempotency claim, and concurrent claims leave exactly one reviewer (FOR UPDATE serialization).

HTTPS preview admissions journey: applicant create→attach→submit (same-key replay), admin self-grant then claim→return(with checklist)→resubmit→decide with SIMULATED label, ungranted-admin + non-grantee denials, foreign-id 404, terminal immutability on both lanes, no studentId claim on the accepted applicant token, applicant/staff portal render.

library.description: P11 exit (domain-contracts §8): simulated library circulation — copy lifecycle AVAILABLE→RESERVED→ON_LOAN→AVAILABLE plus soft RETIRED preserving loan history, request lifecycle REQUESTED→APPROVED→ISSUED→RETURNED|CANCELLED, STAFF:library-scoped desk authority with admin-managed grants, transactional copy locking with a unique-active-loan invariant, server-clock reservation expiry, idempotent request/issue/return (returning twice never inflates stock), owner-indistinguishable 404 isolation, inactive-account denial, catalogue availability driven by server state, and status-change notifications. library-contract is the H2 MockMvc matrix; library-postgres-race runs LibraryInventoryPostgresIT on a disposable compose Postgres (request race collapse, double-issue serialization, return stock restoration); library-e2e drives the HTTPS preview patron+desk journey with isolation and grant-authority legs.

cases.description: LIB-T01..T05 + LIB-X01/X02 on H2 (MockMvc matrix): request→approve→issue→return state machine with copy flips in the same transaction, owner cancel before issue plus staff cancel with reason, issued loans rejecting cancel on both lanes, server-clock expiry on reads AND mutation lanes — approve and issue both deny an expired hold deterministically (RESERVATION_EXPIRED) and a patron request on a dead-hold copy sweeps it and succeeds, missing/stale version 400/409 (approve leg; issue-stale proven in e2e), same-key request/cancel replay + different-payload IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT, second-request-on-held-copy denial, double-return never inflating stock, retire preserving loan history while blocking active copies, grant-required denials (LIBRARY_STAFF_REQUIRED incl. ungranted ADMIN), grant-administration denials (LIBRARY_ADMIN_REQUIRED on a grant-holder without the ADMIN role), STAFF_GRANTED audit rows, indistinguishable 404 foreign isolation, inactive-account request denial, and status-change notification rows on approve/issue/expire.
Native patron library surface: 25-screen registry incl. library, route-map round-trip, source scans.

LIB-X02/T04 on real Postgres: concurrent requests on one copy collapse to a single REQUESTED row via the unique-active-request index, double issue serializes to one ISSUED transition under FOR UPDATE copy locking, and return restores stock exactly once even under retry.

HTTPS preview library journey: patron catalogue→hold (same-key replay), admin self-grant then approve→issue→return with availability decrement/restore, stale-version 409 on issue retry, double-return never inflating stock, ungranted-admin + non-grantee denials, foreign-id 404, terminal row with no desk actions, patron/staff portal render.

careers.description: P12 exit (domain-contracts §9): simulated moderated careers — opportunity lifecycle DRAFT→IN_REVIEW→PUBLISHED→PAUSED→CLOSED plus IN_REVIEW→REJECTED, application lifecycle SUBMITTED→REVIEWING→INTERVIEW→OFFER→REJECTED|WITHDRAWN strictly forward, organization-scoped recruiter grants (careers:<org>) with platform reviewers (empty-org grant) moderating publication and never their own submission (SELF_PUBLISH_FORBIDDEN), one-active-application-per-opportunity, moderation reasons required and visible on REJECTED/PAUSED/CLOSED, owner-indistinguishable 404 candidate isolation, attachment sha256 ownership, and no academic/admissions data bleed into the recruiter lane. careers-contract is the H2 MockMvc matrix; careers-postgres-race runs CareerApplicationPostgresIT on a disposable compose Postgres (same-candidate apply collapse, transition and publish serialization); careers-e2e drives the HTTPS preview candidate+desk journey with isolation, XSS and authority legs.

cases.description: CAR-T01..T07 + CAR-X01/X02 on H2 (MockMvc matrix): draft→submit-review→publish→apply→REVIEWING→INTERVIEW→OFFER lifecycle, reviewer-cannot-moderate-own-submission (SELF_PUBLISH_FORBIDDEN on publish AND reject, second reviewer publishes), org isolation on queue/detail/write lanes, ungranted ADMIN + non-grantee + reviewer-on-recruiter-lane denials, grant-administration denials (CAREERS_ADMIN_REQUIRED), pause/close with visible reason and terminal no-new-applications, one-active-application-per-opportunity with withdraw-then-reapply, idempotent apply/withdraw replay + IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT, rejection requiring a candidate-visible moderation reason, strictly-forward progression (skip and backwards APPLICATION_STATE_INVALID, STALE_VERSION), attachment Idempotency-Key + checksum verify/mismatch + owner/staff/foreign/cross-org reads, indistinguishable 404 candidate isolation, suspended-account denial, and no studentId/gpa/grade/admissions fields in the recruiter lane.
Native candidate careers surface: 26-screen registry incl. careers, route-map round-trip, source scans.

CAR-T04/T05/T02 on real Postgres: concurrent applies by one candidate collapse to a single active application via the partial unique index (distinct candidates all succeed), two org-staff lanes racing SUBMITTED→REVIEWING serialize to exactly one transition, two reviewer lanes racing publish serialize to exactly one PUBLISHED row.

HTTPS preview careers journey: grant orchestration (org recruiter, reviewer, cross-org), draft→submit-review→SELF_PUBLISH_FORBIDDEN→second-reviewer publish, apply with same-key replay + duplicate denial, attachment sha256 upload with owner/staff/foreign/cross-org download legs, strictly-forward progression to OFFER, withdraw replay + reapply, rejection reason visible to candidate, closed posting denying new applications, XSS title rendering as text, candidate board + recruiter desk + cross-org empty lane portal render.

devices.description: P13 native device acceptance (phase-13): native coverage of every domain lane (news/docs read+search, events register, LMS draft/submit, admissions draft/submit/status, library request/history, careers apply/status — no web-handoff-only screens), universal/app-link association contract on the exact www host with auth-callback and API lanes excluded, and per-OS device evidence. devices-mobile-* legs run the native suite + typecheck; devices-association checks the committed .well-known + app.json contract. The per-OS physical/emulator legs (install/update/restart/reinstall, key invalidation, browser SSO, picker, slow/cold API, denied role, logout/replay) are an EXTERNAL capability — recorded BLOCKED_CAPABILITY until EAS/signing/device access is supplied; see docs/ecosystem/device-runbook.md.

cases.description: npm test --prefix mobile: 28-screen registry + route-map parity, domain-contracts coverage (every domain lane calls the API, no website-handoff screens), deep-link guard, session/OIDC flows
npm run typecheck --prefix mobile over the 28-screen tree incl. news/docs surfaces

scripts/ecosystem-devices-verify.mjs: .well-known AASA + assetlinks exist, synthetic identifiers only (real TeamID/fingerprint from secret store at signing), /session/* and /api/* excluded, business lanes scoped to www.campusute.io.vn, app.json associatedDomains + autoVerify intent filters

Android device lane (physical/emulator): install → update → restart → reinstall, key invalidation, browser SSO, picker, slow/cold API, denied role, logout/replay. EXTERNAL capability — no runner exists today; declare ECO_CAP_DEVICES_ANDROID=1 and register a runner when device access is supplied. Until then this case reports BLOCKED_CAPABILITY so the gate report never reads as full device coverage. See docs/ecosystem/device-runbook.md + device-evidence-template.md.

iOS device lane (physical/simulator): install → update → restart → reinstall, key invalidation, browser SSO, picker, slow/cold API, denied role, logout/replay. EXTERNAL capability — no runner exists today; declare ECO_CAP_DEVICES_IOS=1 and register a runner when device access is supplied. Until then this case reports BLOCKED_CAPABILITY so the gate report never reads as full device coverage. See docs/ecosystem/device-runbook.md + device-evidence-template.md.

demo.description: P14 demo rehearsal + operations (phase-14): candidate manifest binds git SHA + source hash + Flyway head + spec/contract digests + per-gate evidence digests (no mixed snapshots); source/docs reconcile (gate citations, i18n vi/en parity, seed-email synthetic allowlist, identity-contract class names); backup→restore parity drill and host probe against a running demo stack; staged deploy + DNS + canary remain external capabilities. The capability-gated legs report BLOCKED_CAPABILITY until their stack/credentials exist — a PASS verdict covers only the executed legs and the report always shows counts.blocked/notRun.

cases.description: ecosystem-release-manifest.mjs: binds candidate to git SHA + source identity + flyway head + spec/contract digests + every artifacts/verification/*/report.json — fails if any gate evidence ran on unstable source or verdict FAIL; dirty worktree is recorded (never releasable) not asserted so the verify leg still proves evidence consistency

ecosystem-reconcile-check.mjs: doc↔manifest agreement — every gate cited in docs/ecosystem/*.md resolves in gates.json, vi/en key parity per i18n message file (mobile + frontend), seed-file email literals inside the synthetic allowlist, identity-contract class names exist
check-migrations.mjs: flyway filename/version hygiene at the release head

ecosystem-backup-drill.mjs: pg_dump → isolated restore → per-table row-count parity + FK parity + orphan checks on the running demo postgres (ECO_DRILL_CONTAINER/ECO_DRILL_DB/ECO_DRILL_WRITER env). Reports BLOCKED_CAPABILITY until ECO_CAP_DEMO_STACK=1 plus a running stack are supplied.

probe-ecosystem-hosts.mjs against live surfaces: AASA/assetlinks synthetic + excludes, CSP, session no-store, apex→portal redirect, id liveness + X-Request-Id. Hosts come from ECO_PROBE_HOST_* env vars; --insecure only for the self-signed preview. Reports BLOCKED_CAPABILITY until ECO_CAP_DEMO_STACK=1 plus running surfaces are supplied.

Staged deploy: API/id image digest first, web hosts, surface registry, canary synthetic personas, full lifecycle suite, live smoke. EXTERNAL — DNS/hosting credentials not supplied; reports BLOCKED_CAPABILITY.

Rollback drill on the declared demo hostname: restore current backup → attachment parity → delta check → reopen; DNS rollback per real records (TTL not instant). EXTERNAL — reports BLOCKED_CAPABILITY.

pilot-preflight.description: P15 real-data pilot gate — separate from the synthetic demo. Registered so doc citations resolve; cases land with the phase. Legal/source-data authority is an external capability until supplied.

cases.description: Legal/source-data authority + real-data import preflight. EXTERNAL — reports BLOCKED_CAPABILITY until the pilot authority exists; the synthetic demo never claims it.
